result: Updated the canonical Mission Canvas projection_digest reducer to hash normalized projection material that retains the exact flattened WorkstreamKey, semantic/profile/activity/read-model revisions, projection and layout revisions, durable event cursor, eligibility decisions, and resolved layout. Volatile digest, resolution-time, Evidence-reference, and Receipt-reference fields remain excluded so proof metadata does not recursively change the digest. Recursive object-key canonicalization makes equivalent transport objects deterministic without reordering composition arrays. Added hostile reducer tests for Workstream separation, revision/cursor changes, proof metadata, key order, omission state, and legacy authority quarantine.

omitted_contribution_reasons: projection digest is a canonical core computation consumed by the Desktop Mission Canvas Svelte projection; it has no direct rendered contribution

negative_cases.foreign_workstream: Equal layout material under different WorkstreamKey values produces different digests. The digest retains the full canonical scope and never maps a foreign Workstream to the local one; exact binding/focus validation remains owned by ResolvedWorkspaceProjection.validate_scope.
negative_cases.missing_authority: The canonical projection serializes a required flattened WorkstreamKey. Removing workstream from a serialized projection fails deserialization; no project_root plus continuity_id fallback is introduced.
negative_cases.stale_revision_cursor: Hostile tests mutate workspace_profile_revision, activity_mode_revision, canonical_read_model_revision, projection_revision, layout_revision, and durable_event_cursor and prove each changes the digest. Optimistic-concurrency acceptance remains owned by core/API revision gates.
negative_cases.unavailable_capability: A capability_not_present omission remains an omission diagnostic and changes digest material; the test keeps eligible_contributions empty, so digest calculation cannot promote or invent an unavailable contribution.
negative_cases.ineligible_or_empty_contribution: Empty/ineligible contribution state is represented through candidate IDs plus omission diagnostics and is included in the digest without creating a layout contribution or substituting content.
negative_cases.ambiguous_legacy_row: A legacy-only project_root/continuity/session/attachment object cannot deserialize as ResolvedWorkspaceProjection. No current-tab, CWD, latest-row, nearest-candidate, or other authority inference was added.

acceptance.statement: Equal layouts under different Workstreams have different digests.
acceptance.proof: mission_canvas_projection_digest_distinguishes_equal_layouts_under_different_workstreams asserts identical layout_tree and distinct canonical WorkstreamKey values produce distinct sha256 digests.

acceptance.statement: project_root plus continuity_id cannot bind or focus a Work Surface.
acceptance.proof: The digest hashes the generated WorkstreamKey rather than a flat project/continuity pair, and the missing-workstream hostile test rejects legacy projection deserialization. CORE-003 exact-scope validation and Spec 158 identity gates pass.

acceptance.statement: ambiguous legacy rows are quarantined, not guessed.
acceptance.proof: mission_canvas_projection_digest_never_repairs_missing_or_foreign_authority proves missing WorkstreamKey is rejected and foreign Workstream material cannot collide; no migration or client inference was introduced.
